post.description: Before query_layer: find the right layer id in a service and the exact field names and codes for a where clause (zoning codes, flood zone values), or check a layer's licence and record limits. Pass a url from search_datasets or a pasted ArcGIS REST URL.

item_id.description: ArcGIS item id of a Feature Service or Map Service (from search_datasets), optionally with a Hub `_<layer>` suffix. Alternative to url. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}(_[0-9]{1,6})?$.

layer.description:
Layer id within the service, when the URL names the service only.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 999999.

url.description: ArcGIS REST service or layer URL, or an ArcGIS Online item page (https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=…). https://<host>/<adaptor>/rest/services/<folder>/<service>/FeatureServer[/<layer>] or …/MapServer[/<layer>], on ArcGIS Online (services*.arcgis.com/<orgId>/arcgis/rest/services/…) or an agency's ArcGIS Server (gis.<agency>.gov/arcgis/rest/services/…). Query strings are ignored; URLs carrying a token or key are refused.

200.description:
Read an ArcGIS FeatureServer or MapServer service, or one of its layers, from its REST URL or ArcGIS item id: the service's layers and tables (id, name, type, geometry type, URL), description, capabilities and record limit; for a layer, its fields (name, alias, type, length, coded-value or range domains), geometry type, object id and display fields, extent (native and WGS84 when convertible), query capabilities and max record count. Always includes attribution: the ArcGIS Online item's licence text and credits plus the copyright text, so results can be credited. Works with ArcGIS Online (services*.arcgis.com) and any agency-hosted ArcGIS Server; the answer must be ArcGIS service JSON, otherwise invalid_input not_arcgis_service. Token-protected services are not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attribution` | object | Who to credit and the terms of use. Licence text and credits come from the ArcGIS Online item behind the service (null for agency servers without one); copyright_text from the service or layer itself. |
| `layer` | object | Layer detail when a layer was named; null for a service. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `service` | object |  |
| `url` | string | Canonical service or layer URL that was read. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Look up the parcel, zoning district, flood zone, permit, address point or boundary at a location or matching an id (e.g. an assessor parcel number), or page through a layer's records. Get field names from describe_layer first.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees.

distance_m.description:
Search radius around point, in metres (default 0: features containing the point).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 50000.

layer.description:
Layer id within the service, when the URL names the service only.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 999999.

limit.description:
Rows per page; the layer's maxRecordCount may cap it lower.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 200; default 25.

offset.description:
Rows to skip (next_offset from the previous page).

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000000; default 0.

order_by.description: `FIELD` or `FIELD DESC`. Default: object id ascending, for stable paging.

out_fields.description: Fields to return (case-insensitive, checked against the layer). Default: all fields.

point.description: WGS84 point: features at (or within distance_m of) this location.

spatial_rel.description:
Relation between the features and point/bbox.

Provider reference: allowed values ["intersects", "contains", "within", "envelope_intersects"]; default "intersects".

url.description: ArcGIS REST service or layer URL: https://<host>/<adaptor>/rest/services/<folder>/<service>/FeatureServer[/<layer>] or …/MapServer[/<layer>], on ArcGIS Online (services*.arcgis.com/<orgId>/arcgis/rest/services/…) or an agency's ArcGIS Server (gis.<agency>.gov/arcgis/rest/services/…). Query strings are ignored; URLs carrying a token or key are refused.

where.description:
ArcGIS SQL-92 where clause, e.g. `PIN = '123-456-789'`, `ZONE_CODE LIKE 'R-%'`, `FLD_ZONE IN ('AE','VE')`.

Provider reference: default "1=1".

200.description:
Query one public ArcGIS feature layer or table (FeatureServer or MapServer layer that supports Query) with an ArcGIS SQL where clause, a WGS84 point (optionally with a search radius in metres) or bounding box, chosen output fields and ordering. Returns compact rows of attributes (date fields as RFC 3339 UTC) and, on request, GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 (6 decimals, vertex-capped), plus the total matching count, next_offset for paging (offset/limit up to 200 per page, respecting the layer's maxRecordCount and exceededTransferLimit) and the layer's attribution (licence, credits, copyright). count_only returns just the count. Works on ArcGIS Online and agency ArcGIS Servers; non-ArcGIS answers are invalid_input not_arcgis_service, token-protected services not_found, server-rejected clauses invalid_input rejected_by_server.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `rows` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attributes` | object | Field name to value, as the layer defines them (dates as RFC 3339 UTC strings, text capped at 2,000 characters). |
| `geometry` | object | RFC 7946 GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 (6 decimals); null when the feature has no geometry or exceeded the vertex cap. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description: Find which public ArcGIS layer holds the data (a county's parcels or zoning, FEMA flood zones, a park's trails, a city's permits) and get its service URL. Start here unless you already have a .../FeatureServer or .../MapServer URL.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees: items whose extent intersects it.

limit.description:
limit

owner.description: ArcGIS username of the publisher (from a previous result's owner).

page.description:
page

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10000; default 1.

q.description: Keywords (ArcGIS search syntax allowed, e.g. `parcels Napa`, `title:zoning`, `tags:flood`).

site.description: An ArcGIS Hub open-data site (hostname or any URL on it, e.g. data-smcmaps.opendata.arcgis.com or opendata.dc.gov). Restricts results to the site's organization.

sort.description:
sort

type.description:
Service type; feature services support the richest queries.

Provider reference: allowed values ["any", "feature_service", "map_service"]; default "any".

200.description:
Search the public ArcGIS Online / ArcGIS Hub catalog (www.arcgis.com portal search) for government GIS layers published as Feature Services or Map Services: parcels, zoning, flood zones, permits, addresses, boundaries and similar. Filter by keywords, one Hub open-data site (e.g. public-nps.opendata.arcgis.com, opendata.dc.gov) or ArcGIS organization id, owner and a WGS84 bounding box; sort by relevance, last modified, views or title; page through up to 10,000 results. Each item has its id, title, type, REST service URL (for describe_layer / query_layer), owner and organization, snippet, tags, dates, authoritative flag, licence and credit text, WGS84 extent and view count. Only public items are returned; there are no credentials.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `access` | string |  |
| `access_information` | string |  |
| `authoritative` | boolean | Marked authoritative by its organization. |
| `bbox` | number[] | [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees; null when unknown or not convertible. |
| `content_status` | string | public_authoritative, org_authoritative, deprecated, or null. |
| `created` | string |  |
| `id` | string | ArcGIS item id; pass as describe_layer item_id. |
| `item_url` | string |  |
| `license_info` | string |  |
| `modified` | string |  |
| `org_id` | string |  |
| `owner` | string | ArcGIS username of the publisher (usable as the owner filter). |
| `snippet` | string |  |
| `tags` | string[] |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `type` | string |  |
| `url` | string | REST service (or layer) URL; pass to describe_layer / query_layer. |
| `views` | number |  |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
